subject.title: improve(control-ui): expose linear session positions in chat picker

question: Should maintainers land this narrow Control UI chat picker accessibility slice after resolving the current-main conflict, while leaving https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/82450 open for the broader linear workspace design?
rationale: The patch is focused and proven, but the protected maintainer label, user-facing accessibility phrasing, conflict state, and partial-overlap relationship with a larger product issue require maintainer intent.

options.title: Land Narrow Slice
options.body: Resolve the conflict, keep the generated locale outputs aligned, and land this selector affordance without treating it as the full workspace solution.

options.title: Request UX Wording Changes
options.body: Ask for different visible ordinal treatment or screen-reader phrasing before merge if maintainers want a different accessibility pattern.

options.title: Pause For Broader Design
options.body: Hold this PR until the larger linear persistent workspace direction is decided, accepting that this smaller picker improvement waits.

recommendation.title: Land Narrow Slice
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflict, keep the generated locale outputs aligned, and land this selector affordance without treating it as the full workspace solution.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent UI localization and adjacent Control UI refactor history make this the best available routing candidate for merge-shape and i18n review.
